limitations: Actual NDK builds and Android13 execution remain pending the new workflow; this review does not establish them.

Existing source-qualified suffix remains standalone raw staging; complete enclosing entity/full-update grammar, dictionary authority, stale-state application and immutable actor publication remain blocked.
Accepted APKs and runtime sources were neither rebuilt nor changed.

review.abi_binding: Both arm64-v8a and x86_64 are mandatory. Each ELF64 little-endian PIE machine is checked, as are exact size, binary SHA, receipt SHA, fixture SHA, source inventory and host receipt equality. Missing/swapped ABI, path escape, source mutation and execution overclaims are refused.
review.android_execution: Only x86_64 runs. Device must report emulator, API 33 and x86_64 ABI; fingerprint retained. Transferred binary SHA checked. Native JSON must exactly match every host mode; sources and full build admission are checked again afterward. ARM64 execution, physical Thor, full update, actor publication and live world are not claimed.
review.clean_checkout: native-android/results/entity-tail/build.json is ignored; generated output does not dirty source. YAML parsed and all four run shell blocks passed bash -n. Python sources parsed.
review.deadlines_and_cleanup: ADB operations default to 60 seconds; native device timeout is 180 seconds with a 240-second host deadline. Owned mktemp path is tightly checked. Exact owned-directory removal and nonexistence confirmation run after success and failure; cleanup failure revokes qualified/pass. An invalid path is never used for deletion.
review.exact_source_closure: All 13 native/test/helper paths required by the Android driver equal the checker hash inventory, current Worker C files, retained host receipt and exact b5df39e6 Git blobs. Local quoted includes close within this inventory except the generated fixture, separately bound by SHA-256.
review.host_binding: Host receipt must be clean, exact revision, full rather than prepare-only, stable before/after, C++ link qualified and contain identical release/ASan/UBSan native results. Strict JSON refuses duplicate keys, non-finite numbers and boolean-as-integer check counts.
review.original_source: All 13 original producer/consumer/header LF pins match actual coordinator originals. Both checker and driver decode UTF-8 and normalize CRLF to LF identically. Eight named complete source functions and oracle_sanitized=false are required; full enclosing entity functions and original dictionary/gameplay authority remain unqualified.
review.publication_markers: Use [native-contracts-only] [compact-recovery] [entity-tail-qualify]. Existing Combined, primary-continuation, scene-catalog and portable-core guards suppress broad qualified rebuilds. Compact-recovery itself is path-scoped to its own unchanged workflow.
review.workflow: One native-android-scoped job, repository guard and entity-tail-qualify push marker; workflow_dispatch allowed only on target branch. Checksummed r28c NDK, both ABI standalone builds and API33 x86_64 emulator. Artifact upload uses always(), exact results tree, missing-files error and 90-day retention. No APK build or unrelated module suite.

cases_passed: success requires exact host result and cleanup
native timeout records attempted but unqualified and cleans
cleanup failure revokes otherwise successful qualification
transfer hash mismatch prevents execution and cleans
invalid temporary path prevents execution and unsafe deletion
wrong SDK prevents temporary allocation and execution
reviewer_focused_controls.kind: Mocked adb lifecycle, synthetic admission fixture only; no device or native code execution.

scope: Read-only independent review of the new standalone suffix Android driver, admission tests and workflow against Worker C checker interface; no native parser, Android, AuthServer, MapServer or APK execution in this review.
